summary: With κ = s + t + 1, some z^b lies in every liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 0, j) with bp ≤ (p − 3)(s+t) + κ + b; expanding p^sE^t = p^s(z + p)^t, each term p^{s+t−m}z^m lies there (mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one and Legendre's formula), so p^{s+t} does and Nakayama removes the modulus.

steps.claim: By exists_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal with κ = s + t + 1: some b with z^b ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{s+t+1}, 0, j) for every j (H) and b·p ≤ (p − 3)(s + t) + (s + t + 1) + b (e; the index e of the chart is 1).
steps.lean: (exists_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal hn (s + t).succ).rec fun b ⟨H, e⟩ ↦ by

steps.claim: Unfold: E = z + p, so p^sE^t = Σ_m binom(t, m)·p^{s+t−m}·z^m.

For every m: p^{s+t−m}·z^m ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{s+t+1}, 0, i), by mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one (c = 0, a = m, n = p·max(b, m)), using z^{p·max(b,m)} ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{s+t+1}, 1, σ(i)) (p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff, a multiple of z^b) and the inequality v_p((p·max(b, m))!) ≤ (s + t − m) + v_p((pm)!), which follows from e and p ≥ 5 by Legendre's formula ((p − 1)v_p(N!) = N − s_p(N)).
